_note: Cancel button for contracts that run over time (subscriptions, memberships), shared by the Shopify app, the WooCommerce plugin and the Shopware plugin. Rules DE-WD-04 (§ 312k BGB) and FR-WD-03 (Code de la consommation L. 215-1-1, D. 215-1 to D. 215-3). German: 'Verträge hier kündigen' (link) and 'jetzt kündigen' (final button) are the words § 312k Abs. 2 BGB names, read on gesetze-im-internet.de on 16 Nov 2026; keep them exact. French: 'résilier votre contrat' (link) and 'notifier la résiliation' (final button) as the Institut national de la consommation (inc-conso.fr, 20 June 2023) quotes décret n° 2023-417 du 31 mai 2023; not yet read on Légifrance (it blocks automated readers). English, Italian and Dutch have no legal wording; the texts are plain equivalents. Placeholders: {date}, {time}, {email}, {contract}, {end}, {shop}, {reference}. Record fields every platform stores: receivedAt (ISO time), reference (C- and 8 letters or digits), name, email, contract, cancelType (ordinary or extraordinary), reason (extraordinary only), endMode (earliest or date), endDate (YYYY-MM-DD when endMode is date), lang, receiptSent, shopCopySent, doneAt (when the shop marked it done). Technical help, not legal advice.

en.heading: Cancel a contract
en.intro: Use this form to cancel a subscription, membership or other contract that runs over time. You get a confirmation by email straight away.
en.name: Your name
en.emailHint: The one you used for the contract. The confirmation goes there.
en.contractHint: For example the order number or the name of the subscription.
en.endDateHint: Only if you chose a date. It cannot be in the past.
en.summaryIntro: Please check your details. Your cancellation is sent only when you press the button below.
en.successBody: We received your cancellation on {date} at {time}. A confirmation is on its way to {email}. Please keep it, or save or print this page.
en.successNoReceipt: We received your cancellation on {date} at {time}, but we could not send the confirmation email. Please save or print this page as your confirmation.
en.endsEarliest: The contract ends at the earliest possible date. The shop will tell you the date.
en.endsOn: You asked for the contract to end on {end}.
en.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
en.invalidDate: Please choose a date from today on.
en.reasonRequired: Please give the reason for an extraordinary cancellation.
en.failed: Your cancellation could not be sent. Please try again in a few minutes.
en.privacy: We use your details only to handle your cancellation.
en.subject: Your cancellation: {contract}
en.received: we received your cancellation on {date} at {time}. These are the details you sent:
en.keep: Please keep this email as your confirmation.
en.shopIntro: A customer cancelled a contract through your cancellation button on {date} at {time}.
en.shopNext: Please end the contract (for a subscription, in your subscriptions app), tell the customer the end date if they chose the earliest possible date, and mark the cancellation as done in Shopproof.
en.shopNoReceipt: The customer did not get the confirmation email. Please confirm the cancellation to them by email.
en.disclaimer: Shopproof gives technical help, not legal advice.

fr.emailHint: Celle utilisée pour le contrat. La confirmation y sera envoyée.

nl.heading: Een contract opzeggen
nl.intro: Met dit formulier zeg je een abonnement, lidmaatschap of ander doorlopend contract op. Je krijgt meteen een bevestiging per e-mail.
nl.name: Je naam
nl.emailHint: Het adres dat je voor het contract hebt gebruikt. De bevestiging gaat daarheen.
nl.contractHint: Bijvoorbeeld het bestelnummer of de naam van het abonnement.
nl.reasonHint: Alleen bij opzegging om een dringende reden.
nl.endDate: Op een datum die ik kies
nl.endDateHint: Alleen als je een datum hebt gekozen. Die mag niet in het verleden liggen.
nl.summaryIntro: Controleer je gegevens. Je opzegging wordt pas verstuurd als je op de knop hieronder drukt.

nl.privacy: We gebruiken je gegevens alleen om je opzegging af te handelen.
